title: Ethereum Test Network Raises Block Limit to Over 3x Its Current Capacity
summary: Ethereum's Sepolia test network activated Glamsterdam on October 6 with a block gas limit near 200 million, over three times mainnet's 60 million.

title: Satoshi-Era Bitcoin Worth $8.3 Million Moves After 16 Years
summary: A batch of 100.02 BTC mined in July 2010 moved Wednesday after 16 years. It's worth about $8.3 million, but nothing in the transaction shows who owns it.

title: Solana DeFi Firms Orca and Loopscale Merge Under New Formation Brand
summary: Solana DEX Orca and lending platform Loopscale will operate as Formation, a New York company aiming to finance AI, energy, robotics and defense assets and eventually reach regulated U.S. markets.

title: Bitcoin ETFs Suffer Worst Loss Since June as Uptober Turns Red
summary: Investors yanked $484.9 million out of spot Bitcoin ETFs in a single day. Oil is near $100, bond yields are at their highest since 2002, and the Fed isn't done hiking.

title: Will AI Break Crypto Encryption? Ethereum’s Vitalik Buterin Weighs In on 'Bunker Mode' Shift
summary: Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin thinks the crypto industry needs to make sure encryption is both quantum and AI-resistant.

title: US Government Moves $1 Billion in Bitcoin Seized From Bitfinex Hacker
summary: A government wallet holding Bitcoin seized from the Bitfinex hacker sent 12,267 BTC to a new, unlabeled address, according to Arkham data.

title: From Uptober to Spooky Szn? Bitcoin Cuts September Gains in Half
summary: Day traders are selling, leveraged longs are getting flushed and ETF money is heading for the door. The daily chart still holds the line, but its cushion is shrinking.

title: Morning Minute: AI Could Break Crypto Encryption Before Quantum, Says Ethereum Researcher
summary: Justin Drake is calling for crypto holders to start calmly planning for “Bunker Mode." But reactions so far haven’t been too calm.

title: Uranium Finance Hacker Who Bought Pokémon and Magic Cards Convicted Over $50M Theft
summary: Jonathan Spalletta also spent stolen crypto on a Roman coin marking Julius Caesar's assassination and moon-flown Wright brothers fabric.

title: Greece Plans 10% Crypto Capital Gains Tax, Down From 15% Floated in June
summary: A draft bill would exempt the first €500 of annual gains, as crypto tax rates across Europe run from Cyprus's 8% to Italy's 33%.

title: Samsung Wallet Taps Solana for USDC Transfers on 82M US Galaxy Devices
summary: Users can send USDC across borders from late October, three months after Samsung teased stablecoin support without naming a blockchain.

title: Ethereum Researcher Says AI May Break Encryption Before Quantum Does
summary: Ethereum Foundation researcher Justin Drake urged holders to calmly move funds to unused addresses, warning that AI-driven math could break crypto signatures before quantum computers do.

title: SEC and CFTC Crypto Rules 'Fall Short' of Clarity, Says Rep. French Hill
summary: The House Financial Services chairman credited the SEC and CFTC for stepping in after the Clarity Act's collapse but said only "permanent law change" can secure U.S. leadership.

title: Tether Signs Deal With Kazakhstan's Central Bank to Explore a Stablecoin and Tokenized Assets
summary: Tether, issuer of the USDT stablecoin, will help Kazakhstan's central bank study a tenge-pegged token and put real-world assets on a blockchain.

title: US Government Moves $103 Million in Seized Bitcoin and BNB, But Hasn't Said Why
summary: Government-labeled wallets sent 833.6 BTC to Coinbase Prime deposit addresses and shuffled 40,285 BNB. No sale is confirmed, but the stash behind it is the largest any government holds in Arkham's ranking.

title: Bitcoin Dips Below $83K as Oil Shock Rattles Markets: What Happens Next?
summary: Bitcoin fell sharply as oil topped $101 and the 30-year Treasury yield hit its highest since 2002. The daily chart still leans bullish. The four-hour chart disagrees.

title: Bitmine's Relentless Ethereum Buying Is About to End, Tom Lee Says
summary: Speaking at Token2049 in Singapore, the chairman said Bitmine is about 100,000 ETH—roughly six to seven weeks—from its 5% cap, setting an end date on a buying spree that made it the world's largest Ethereum treasury.

title: Engineer Gets 32 Months for Bitcoin Extortion Plot Against His Own Employer
summary: Daniel Rhyne locked his company's IT administrators out of its network and demanded 20 BTC, then worth $750,000, to stop the shutdowns.

title: Morning Minute: OKX Raises at $25B From Circle, Ripple, and StanChart
summary: OKX raises more, $500M+ in crypto longs liquidated after a late evening selloff, and Abstract calls it quits.
